After calling bind(onChange), filter interactions trigger the onChange callback with current filter state

All filter bars use the .filter-bar class family
Filter interaction in project-list (status/runner/search) works correctly after migration
Filter interaction in insights view works correctly after migration

summary: Implemented UI.filterBar(containerId, filters) in components.js returning { html, bind } with support for type:'select'|'text', optionsHtml (pre-built options), options array, placeholder, value, cssClass, and label (optional)
Removed .insights-filters CSS block (and its sub-rules) from styles.css; updated dark theme selector to drop duplicate .insights-filters select rule
Migrated insights.js from inline .insights-filters div + 6 separate addEventListener calls to UI.filterBar() with fb.bind(onChange)

Migrated knowledge.js: replaced buildFilterBarHtml() with buildKnFilters() using UI.filterBar(); removed wireFilterBarEvents(); updated render(), renderFilterBar() (outerHTML replacement), and wireEvents(fb) signature
Migrated project-list.js: replaced inline .filter-bar HTML + 3 separate event wiring blocks with UI.filterBar('pl-filter-bar', ...) + plFb.bind() with inline debounce for search
Browser-verified: all 3 views render and filter correctly with .filter-bar class, no JS errors, .insights-filters removed from DOM, Repository tab switch rebuilds filter bar correctly

comments.note: UI.filterBar() uses container.querySelector('#' + f.id) for event delegation. If a filter id ever contained CSS special characters (e.g. dots), the selector would break. All current ids are alphanumeric+hyphens so this is safe, but worth documenting in the JSDoc.

knowledge.js buildKnFilters() passes cssClass:'form-control form-control-sm' to all filter controls. The form-control-sm class has no definition in styles.css — it is inherited from an earlier Bootstrap-like approach and is effectively a no-op. Consider either defining the class or removing it in a follow-up cleanup.

insights.js filter state (filterType, filterPriority, filterProject) is reset to 'ALL' on every API reload (render() is called fresh). If future caching or partial updates are added, the filter state will need to survive render cycles — consider persisting to sessionStorage like project-list does with localStorage.

project-list.js now has a searchDebounceTimer closure variable declared at the outer renderProjectList() scope but used exclusively within the plFb.bind() callback. The pattern is consistent with how the original code used it — just noting for QA reviewers that clearTimeout(searchDebounceTimer) inside bind() correctly references the closure variable.

summary: AC1-3 (UI.filterBar API): Verified in browser — returns {html, bind}, html uses .filter-bar class wrapper, bind() triggers onChange with full {[id]:value} state on filter interactions.
AC4 (.insights-filters removed): Confirmed absent from styles.css (grep: 0 matches) and from the live DOM.
AC5 (all filter bars use .filter-bar): All 3 call sites (insights.js, knowledge.js, project-list.js) produce .filter-bar wrappers. Verified in browser.
AC6 (project-list filter interaction): Status filter change from COMPLETE to ACTIVE correctly updated the project table from 2 to 3 rows. Filter bar persists across DOM reload.
AC7 (insights filter interaction): insights-filter-bar rendered with Type/Priority/Project dropdowns. No .insights-filters class in DOM.
AC8 (knowledge filter interaction): Global tab shows kn-category + kn-query. Repository tab switch rebuilds filter bar via outerHTML replacement — adds kn-repository dropdown correctly.
AC9 (no JS errors): Zero console errors across knowledge, insights, project-list, config, and orchestrator views.
Full test suite: all 3095 tests pass.

comments.note: UI.filterBar() bind() uses container.querySelector('#' + f.id) for event delegation. All current IDs are alphanumeric+hyphens so safe, but if an ID ever contained CSS special characters (e.g. dots) the selector would break. Low risk given controlled internal usage.
knowledge.js kn-filter-bar uses id='kn-repository' for the Repository tab select (not 'kn-repo'). This is consistent with the existing code — just noting the actual ID for future test authors.

project-list filter change fires immediately for status/runner, but search uses 300ms debounce. Both paths verified in browser: status filter change from COMPLETE to ACTIVE correctly showed 3 projects (up from 2), filter bar reconstructed correctly after DOM reload.

summary: Reviewed UI.filterBar(containerId, filters) implementation in components.js — correct { html, bind } design, clean separation of HTML generation from event attachment. Supports select/text types, optionsHtml pass-through, cssClass, label, placeholder, and value pre-population.

Reviewed all 3 migration call sites: insights.js (filter state restored before bind()), project-list.js (search debounce inside bind() callback — correct), knowledge.js (outerHTML replacement pattern for tab-switch filter bar rebuild — correct).

Fix-Forward applied: changed bind() to use document.getElementById(f.id) instead of container.querySelector('#' + f.id). Eliminates CSS selector string construction and any theoretical CSS-escape edge case. Equivalent under valid DOM — IDs are unique per spec. Verified: all 3095 tests pass.
CSS unification confirmed: .insights-filters block removed from styles.css and dark-mode override. All filter bars now use .filter-bar class family.
No blocking issues. The form-control-sm no-op debt in knowledge.js is pre-existing and correctly scoped as out-of-WP cleanup.

comments.note: components.js UI.filterBar() bind(): replaced container.querySelector('#' + f.id) with document.getElementById(f.id) in both the listener-attach loop and the state-collection closure. Eliminates the CSS-escape edge case flagged by Developer and QA. Equivalent under valid DOM (IDs are unique per spec); all 3095 tests pass after the change.

knowledge.js renderFilterBar() outerHTML pattern: fb.bind() must always be called after outerHTML replacement or the rebuilt filter bar will be unresponsive. This ordering is correct in the current code; worth a comment above the outerHTML line to prevent future regression.

knowledge.js buildKnFilters() uses cssClass:'form-control form-control-sm' on all controls. Developer already noted form-control-sm has no definition in styles.css — confirming it is a no-op. Not blocking; existing debt, flagged for future cleanup.

notes: UI.filterBar(containerId, filters) is now in components.js (last function before the return). Supports: type:'select' with options array or optionsHtml string; type:'text' with placeholder+value; optional label (omitted if falsy), cssClass, id.
bind(onChange) attaches change/input listeners to all filter controls and calls onChange({[id]:value,...}) with the full state on every interaction.
insights.js uses id='insights-filter-bar'; project-list.js uses id='pl-filter-bar'; knowledge.js uses id='kn-filter-bar' (same as before, preserved for renderFilterBar partial-update logic).

knowledge.js renderFilterBar() now uses filterBarEl.outerHTML = fb.html to replace the outer wrapper element, then calls fb.bind() — this is required because UI.filterBar() produces the full div including its id.

project-list.js search debounce is handled inside the bind() callback by comparing newSearch !== currentSearch before triggering a debounced reload; status/runner changes are handled in the else branch.
Verify: (1) filter state persists across re-renders in project-list, (2) tab switch in knowledge rebuilds filter bar with repository dropdown, (3) search debounce delay is ~300ms.

All 9 ACs verified. UI.filterBar() API correct in browser (returns {html, bind}, bind triggers onChange with full state). .insights-filters class removed from CSS and DOM. All 3 views (project-list, insights, knowledge) render and filter correctly with .filter-bar class. Knowledge Repository tab switch rebuilds filter bar with kn-repository dropdown. Zero console errors across all views.
All 3095 tests pass — no regressions introduced by WP-007 changes.
Fix-Forward applied: bind() now uses document.getElementById(f.id) instead of container.querySelector('#' + f.id) — eliminates CSS-selector edge case, all 3095 tests pass.

Minor observation: knowledge.js renderFilterBar() outerHTML pattern requires fb.bind() to always follow the outerHTML assignment. Current code is correct; consider adding an inline comment as a guard for future maintainers.
